question: A rectangular floor measuring 10 m x 8 m is to be tiled. If each tile covers 0.25 m², how many tiles are needed?
solution:
The correct answer is __320__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Calculation:__
 
• The area of the rectangular floor = 10 m × 8 m = 80 m².
 
• Area covered by each tile = 0.25 m².
 
• Number of tiles required = 80 ÷ 0.25 = 320.
 
• Therefore, the total number of tiles required is 320.
